title: Raspberry Pi Pico W as USB Wi-Fi Adapter
summary: A creative project that transforms the Raspberry Pi Pico W into a USB Wi-Fi adapter, allowing computers or devices without built-in Wi-Fi to connect to wireless networks through the Pico W's CYW43439 chip via USB interface.
problem_solved: Enables devices lacking Wi-Fi capability to connect to wireless networks by repurposing the affordable Pico W as a USB Wi-Fi dongle.
why_valuable: Provides a cost-effective and flexible solution for adding Wi-Fi connectivity to any USB-enabled device using readily available and inexpensive hardware.
